what: Pressing the three-dot accent-color button makes the panel, folded to button size (56px), swell with a wobble to 212×398 over .9s elastic.out(1,.62) and become a menu, while the top·bottom dots lengthen into 24×3 bars and rotate ±45° to overlap as an X, and the center dot disappears in .2s. Menu rows float up from 8px below in .5s at .05s intervals after .22s. Pressing again, or clicking outside, pressing Esc or a menu link, turns the rows off in .2s, and .2s later the panel·dots return over .45s power3.inOut

options.size: Size (px) of the closed panel and button, default 56 — keep the same as --fx-size in css
options.off: Distance (px) the top and bottom points move toward the center, default 10
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Expanding panel (child) — attached to the same corner (top right) as the button
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Menu rows inside the panel — rising in order

use: Menu 1
